channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Eleitores do Paraná decidem em plebiscito inédito se comunidade mudará de cidade
item.description: Paraná will hold Brazil's first-ever plebiscite to determine whether a community's territory should be transferred between two municipalities during the second round of elections, giving voters a direct say on regional territorial reorganization.

item.title: Míssil inflável 'explode' no colo de Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro faces criticism following an incident involving an inflatable missile during a political event. The text also mentions pro-Lula protests on Avenida Paulista and allegations of vandalism against a subway station. The scenario highlights tensions between supporters of different political spectrums in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Apoiadores de Lula vão às ruas no Rio, Brasília, Salvador e BH na reta final do segundo turno
item.description: Supporters of President Luiz Inácio Lula Silva (PT) held protests in four major Brazilian capitals — Rio de Janeiro, Salvador, Brasília, and Belo Horizonte — on Sunday, April 18, rallying behind his re-election campaign in the final week before the second round of elections.

item.title: Adesivaço pró-Flávio Bolsonaro reúne apoiadores na Praça Rui Barbosa, em Apucarana
item.description: A sticker campaign in support of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro gathered hundreds of supporters at Praça Rui Barbosa in Apucarana. The PL member is a pre-candidate for the Presidency of the Republic in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Manifestantes denunciam agressões de bolsonaristas em dia de atos em SP
item.description: Protesters reported attacks by Bolsonaro supporters against Lula followers during demonstrations at train stations in São Paulo. Videos circulating on social media show clashes at two metro stations, raising concerns about the safety of political gatherings. The allegations highlight growing tension between groups ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Messias posta mensagem de ‘Exército do Lula’ convocando para atos no Rio de Janeiro
item.description: Attorney General Jorge Messias shared a call from 'Lula's Army', a WhatsApp group coordinated by Congressman André Janones, urging supporters to attend rallies in Rio de Janeiro this Sunday.

item.title: Janones posta foto sua em debate: “General chegou”
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) attended President Lula's debate on Band and skipped a Rio rally to support reelection. He leads the PT's digital campaign through the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel with over 5 million followers.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: veja quando saem as novas pesquisas Datafolha, Quaest e mais
item.description: This week, before the 2026 presidential runoff, several polling firms will release new surveys, including Datafolha, Quaest, Real Time Big Data, and AtlasIntel. These polls measure the race between President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), with interviews conducted between October 15 and 24.

item.title: Os artistas que participaram de atos pró-Lula neste domingo em todo o Brasil
item.description: On Sunday, numerous Brazilian artists took part in campaign events across the country in support of President Lula's re-election. Musicians such as Caetano Veloso, Chico Buarque, Marisa Monte, Djavan, and Fernanda Abreu, along with actress Sônia Braga, rallied alongside members of the PT party to defend democracy.

item.title: Debate presidencial en Brasil, en vivo | Lula y Bolsonaro se miden cara a cara por primera vez en las elecciones
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula face off in the first runoff debate, hosted by TV Band, one week before the election. Both skipped debates in the first round. Polls show a technical tie after Bolsonaro led with 47% vs Lula's 45% in the first round.

item.title: Em debate, Lula ficará de frente com outros adversários além de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: President Lula will face former judge Sergio Moro and ex-Lava Jato official Deltan Dallagnol—accusators who sentenced him to prison in 2018—at the first-debate with his main rival, Federal Deputy Flavio Bolsonaro (PL). The debate was canceled hours before broadcast due to judicial rulings blocking its format, as only one prior debate involving minor parties had taken place.

item.title: Antes de debate com Flávio, Lula posta foto se preparando
item.description: Lula posted a photo preparing for the first debate of the runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro, broadcast by Band this Sunday. Polls indicate Flávio ahead in most surveys, although the latest shows a technical tie between the candidates.

item.title: “A expectativa é que ajude um pouco”, diz Lula sobre debate na Band
item.description: President Lula said he expects the Band debate with Flávio Bolsonaro to help clarify the candidates' proposals for the second round. He stated he hopes the meeting is marked by civility, without provocations or insults, and that it may help voters a bit.

item.title: Flávio chega a debate da “Band” acompanhado de Tarcísio e Nikolas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro participated in the first direct debate against Lula on Band, accompanied by Tarcísio de Freitas, Nikolas Ferreira, and other allies. The clash marks a decisive moment of the second round, with Flávio leading most polls, although the latest survey shows a technical tie at 50% to 50% in valid votes. The second round takes place on October 25, 2026.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro realiza manifestação na Paulista
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) held a rally on Avenida Paulista one week before the runoff, pledging to appoint anti-abortion and anti-drug STF justices and suggesting his father Jair Bolsonaro, under house arrest, would hand him the presidential sash. Supporters displayed a replica missile reading 'Trump nuke Brazil'. Voters cited security and economy as key motivations.

item.title: Flávio tem 52% dos votos válidos, contra 48% de Lula, aponta Gerp
item.description: A new survey by the Gerp institute shows that Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads the vote intention with 52%, against 48% for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the second round of the presidential election. Bolsonaro's advantage over the PT candidate narrowed from ten to four percentage points.

item.title: AO VIVO: acompanhe o debate entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro na Band
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro hold a presidential debate live on Band TV. The debate marks their first direct confrontation ahead of the runoff election.

item.title: Flávio diz que vai “esfregar verdades”; Lula quer discutir o Brasil
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula delivered contrasting speeches before the first presidential debate of the second round, scheduled for this Sunday on Band. The PL senator promised to confront Lula with what he called truths to combat lies from the Workers' Party campaign, while Lula defended a civilized debate focused on proposals for Brazil and criticized the politics of insults. Flávio also compared his team to names such as Tarcísio de Freitas and Daniella Marques, contrasting them with figures like Haddad and Dilma in Lula's government.

item.title: STF abre inquérito para apurar suposta lavagem de dinheiro envolvendo Flávio Bolsonaro e o advogado Willer Tomaz
item.description: The Supreme Court opened an investigation into alleged money laundering involving lawyer Willer Tomaz and Senator and presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro. Justice Alexandre de Moraes was designated as rapporteur, based on digital evidence obtained by federal police in Rio Grande do Sul. An email dated May 2025 reveals that Flávio was a 'master user' of an account linked to Tomaz's company, and investigators found documents showing close ties between the two.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio quer Moro em primeira fila do debate para provocar Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign aims to provoke Lula by having Sergio Moro, the former judge in the Lava Jato operation and Paraná governor-elect, join the audience of the Band debate. Accompanied by ex-prosecutor Deltan Dallagnol, Moro arrived at the São Paulo studio as part of a strategy to destabilize the PT candidate.

item.title: Antes de debate, Lula chama Flávio de “irmãozão dos criminosos” no Zap
item.description: Lula's campaign sent a WhatsApp message calling Flávio Bolsonaro "big brother of criminals" three hours before their first presidential debate of the 2026 runoff, mediated by Band in São Paulo. Recent polls show Flávio leading in 11 of 13 surveys, with a technical tie at 50% each in the latest PoderData/Aya poll. The runoff is scheduled for October 25.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro é alvo de segundo inquérito no STF por suspeita de lavagem de dinheiro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro has become the target of a second investigation at the Supreme Federal Court, investigated by the Federal Police on suspicion of money laundering related to irregularities in betting platforms and digital payment systems. The probe points to ties between the lawmaker and lawyer Willer Tomaz, with evidence of travel payments, suspicious bank accounts, and access to the senator's personal data.

item.title: Lula deve apostar em “batalha de biografias” contra Flávio na Band
item.description: Lula is expected to focus on contrasting his political trajectory with Flávio Bolsonaro in the Band debate, highlighting social achievements and challenging the opponent's record. The strategy includes emphasizing programs like Bolsa Família and Pé-de-Meia, along with attacks on allegations involving the Bolsonaro family.

item.title: Em debate na Band, Lula fica à direita e Flávio, à esquerda na tela
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro face each other for the first round in the 2026 elections during a debate on TV Bandeirantes. An irony emerges as Lula's podium, historically from the left, is positioned to the right on screen, while Flávio's, from the right, sits to the left. The debate takes place at a decisive campaign moment, ahead of the presidential runoff vote.

item.title: ‘O Brasil não é um quintal’: ato pró-Lula toma a Union Square, em Nova York. Veja fotos e vídeos
item.description: Supporters of President Lula held pro-Lula rallies in multiple cities worldwide, including New York, with slogans such as 'Brazil is not anyone's backyard'. The demonstrations were part of an international mobilization in support of the PT leader.

item.title: Relembre como foi o debate entre Lula e Bolsonaro na “Band” em 2022
item.description: The first 2022 runoff debate between Lula and Bolsonaro on Band featured mutual accusations over pandemic management, corruption, and Petrobras. Bolsonaro touched Lula's shoulder twice saying "Stay here, Lula," a gesture that drew attention due to the format allowing free movement. Lula led early discussion on pandemic response, while Bolsonaro gained ground later focusing on corruption allegations.

item.title: Há 4 anos, Lula debatia com Bolsonaro pai na Band; relembre destaques
item.description: Four years ago, on October 16, 2022, Lula and Jair Bolsonaro faced off in the first debate of the presidential runoff by TV Band. The debate was marked by strong confrontations over the pandemic, corruption, and the economy. Now in 2026, Lula is debating a Bolsonaro again, this time facing Jair's son, Flávio Bolsonaro, also running for president.

item.title: Flávio e Lula já estão na sede da Band: em breve começa o debate
item.description: Flavio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Infillo da Silva (PT) face off in their first-ever presidential debate on Sunday, November 18th, broadcast live by Band. The event, organized by several major media outlets, will feature direct exchanges of ideas through prepared questions from moderators in front of a national audience.

item.title: Flávio é alvo de novo inquérito por suspeita de lavagem de dinheiro
item.description: The Federal Police sent an investigation to the Supreme Court regarding suspected money laundering involving Senator and presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and lawyer Willer Tomaz, according to O Estado de S. Paulo. The probe identifies meetings between them, payments for trips to the legislator, and ties linking them to the alleged offense.

item.title: Advogado próximo a Flávio Bolsonaro rebate acusações de Richarlison envolvendo ilha
item.description: Willer Tomaz, lawyer close to Flávio Bolsonaro, refuted Richarlison's accusations about possession of an island in Angra dos Reis, presenting documents proving his registered title and payment of property debts. He stated that Justice already ruled on the case with a final decision, that the player's company withdrew from the process to avoid paying court costs, and that police archived the investigation due to lack of criminal evidence.

item.title: Debate de Lula e Flávio na “Band” será às 20h; saiba como assistir
item.description: President Lula and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro will face off in the first direct debate of the runoff this Sunday (Oct 18) at 8 PM on Band. The broadcast will air on open TV, cable, internet, streaming, and radio, with an expected two-hour duration.

item.title: AO VIVO Debate da Band: Lula e Flávio debatem pela primeira vez nas eleições 2026
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro will hold the first runoff debate of the 2026 elections on Band TV at 8:15 PM, delayed by 15 minutes. After negotiations and back-and-forth on participation, both confirmed attendance in a tight race with polls showing a technical tie.

item.title: Debate na Band: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro se enfrentam antes do 2º turno
item.description: Lula arrived at the Band debate accompanied by Janja and said he hopes proposals can be debated. He stated he does not know if experience will make a difference and criticized the impoverishment of Brazilian politics. The president highlighted that he travels the country and uses television to convince voters.

item.title: Em Paris, apoiadores de Lula reivindicam o verde-amarelo e pedem votos no segundo turno
item.description: Lula's supporters gathered in Paris to mobilize votes for the runoff, claiming the green and yellow after pro-democracy demonstrations across Brazil.

item.title: Lobista põe Lulinha na marca do pênalti, e Flávio Bolsonaro chuta
item.description: Lulinha, investigated for influence peddling, became a liability to his father Lula during the 2026 election campaign, drawing criticism. Flávio Bolsonaro leveraged the issue to attack the PT, escalating tensions between the two sides. The episode underscores the role of lobbyists and politicians' children in the electoral race.

item.title: Confira o calendário das últimas pesquisas sobre a disputa presidencial antes do 2º turno
item.description: The week leading up to the 2026 presidential runoff will feature multiple voter intention surveys, scheduled from Monday 19 to Saturday 24. Institutes such as Datafolha, PoderData, Quaest, Ipespe, and Nexus will update the race between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The surveys use varying methodologies and generally indicate a tight race.

item.title: Que horas é o debate da Band? Veja horário, regras e como assistir ao primeiro confronto entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The first presidential debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro takes place at 8 PM on TV Band, also broadcast on other media. The format includes three blocks with moderator questions, direct confrontations, and closing statements. The second debate is scheduled for October 23rd on Globo.

item.title: “Band” instala grades para separar apoiadores de Lula e Flávio
item.description: Band installed barriers to separate supporters of Lula and Flávio outside its headquarters during the presidential debate promoted by the network. The gathering takes place one week before the second round of voting, scheduled for October 25, 2026.

item.title: Apoiadores de Lula fazem ato com Caetano Veloso, Djavan e outros artistas em Copacabana
item.description: Supporters of Lula held the 'Musical Act for Democracy' in Copacabana, promoting democracy and conscious voting ahead of the runoff. Artists like Caetano Veloso, Djavan, and Xamã combined music and political speeches.

item.title: Por que o TSE mudou 2.000 seções eleitorais agora e quais as regiões mais afetadas
item.description: The TSE changed 2,000 polling stations due to adverse weather conditions and venue issues, with the Northeast region being most affected. Voters can check their polling stations on the TSE website or via the e-Título app.

item.title: Lula pede ao TSE alerta de seções alteradas e transporte a eleitores
item.description: Lula's coalition 'Brasil Pronto Pra Mais' requested urgent measures from the TSE to ensure free public transportation and individual notification for voters whose polling sections were changed for the runoff election, claiming that communication via websites and apps only increased abstention in the first round.

item.title: Moro quer proteção policial para amiga de Lulinha
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro announced he will request police protection for businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger, who declared fearing for her and her daughters' safety. In a social media video, Moro advocated for an investigation into the accusations made by Luchsinger against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro é investigado em 2º inquérito no STF para apurar suspeitas de lavagem com advogado
item.description: The Federal Police sent a new inquiry to the STF investigating Flávio Bolsonaro over money laundering suspicions tied to lawyer Willer Tomaz and the Rede Loto. The case was assigned to Minister Alexandre de Moraes and raises to two the inquiries against the senator at the STF.

item.title: Ato de Flávio reúne 76.200 na Paulista a uma semana do 2º turno
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign rally on Paulista Avenue gathered around 76,200 people, according to Poder360's estimate. It was the largest pro-Bolsonaro turnout at the location since Jair Bolsonaro's event in February 2024. The rally took place one week before the first round of the 2026 presidential elections.

item.title: Senador Marcos Pontes quer impedir ex-ministros do STF de disputar eleições
item.description: Senator Marcos Pontes (PL-SP) introduced a bill barring Supreme Court justices from running for office for eight years after leaving the bench, including retroactively for those still within the window. The measure amends the Ineligibility Law to prevent misuse of institutional influence in future candidacies.

item.title: Lula x Flávio para presidente: o que dizem as pesquisas e a agenda de novos levantamentos
item.description: A week before the runoff, polls show a technical tie between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, each with 50% of valid votes. The race remains tight, and new polls are expected to update the electoral scenario ahead of Sunday's vote.

item.title: Autor do pedido de impeachment de Dilma faz o “L” em apoio a Lula
item.description: Jurist Miguel Reale Júnior, author of the impeachment request against Dilma Rousseff, declared support for Lula's re-election to preserve democracy. Reale also announced his vote against Flávio Bolsonaro, arguing that his victory would threaten democracy and could lead to amnesty for those involved in the January 8 attacks. The campaign encourages Lula supporters to use national symbols to dispute the narrative on social media.

item.title: Flávio é retrocesso, diz mãe de Paulo Gustavo, que viu Bolsonaro rir
item.description: Paulo Gustavo's mother publicly criticizes Flávio Bolsonaro, saying his surname reminds her of her son who died from COVID-19, and urges voting for Lula to prevent a return to the pandemic-era government. The piece highlights the CPI investigation into Bolsonaro and the failures in vaccine access and public health during the pandemic.

item.title: Os eleitores que decidem o 2º turno, segundo cartilha da campanha de Lula
item.description: Lula's campaign strategy focuses on mobilizing 40% of first-turn abstainers and attracting Cury voters. The plan combines voter turnout incentives, direct engagement with moderate urban voters, and targeted media messaging.

item.title: Janones cancela ida a ato para ajudar Lula em debate
item.description: Federal congressman André Janones (Rede-MG) canceled his participation in a pro-Lula rally in Rio to join the president during a Band debate. He emphasized analyzing arguments from both sides and highlighted his over 5 million WhatsApp followers as 'democracy soldiers.' The debate will be the first direct face-off between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in the campaign, amid a context of event cancellations and candidate absences.
